question: Should OpenClaw own Twilio RCS as a bundled first-class channel, or should this implementation ship as an external plugin?
rationale: VISION.md favors external ownership for optional plugins, but selected major messaging channels may be bundled; only maintainers can choose the support and release obligation.

options.title: External RCS plugin
options.body: Publish the RCS channel independently and upstream only any missing generic Plugin SDK seam.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept ongoing OpenClaw responsibility for Twilio compatibility, security, setup, documentation, and release validation.

recommendation.title: External RCS plugin
recommendation.body: Publish the RCS channel independently and upstream only any missing generic Plugin SDK seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The bundled Twilio SMS channel is the closest product precedent and code-ownership history for this choice.
